c74object.name: evi_ssb.genexpr.genexpr
c74object.digest:
evi_ssb.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the "evieve" Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_ssb.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_ssb.genexpr file also requires:
evi_sinfold_lib.genexpr
evi_cossin.genexpr
evi_biquad.genexpr
evi_rcfilters.genexpr
